findings.highlight: Servants have more freedom to kill innocent people without having anyone notice
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントが徘徊した時、町の人たちは何の抵抗も出来ず、人知れず犠牲になる恐れ
findings.governingReading: if a Servant roams under cover of night, townspeople may become unseen victims without any power to resist
findings.explanation: A specific feared scenario becomes a general claim about Servants’ freedom, and the victims’ helplessness disappears.

findings.highlight: other Masters won’t be able to do anything so easily
findings.evidenceJa: 他のマスターも動きにくいだろう
findings.governingReading: other Masters will probably find it difficult to act
findings.explanation: A probabilistic constraint on movement or operations becomes vague inability to do anything.

findings.evidenceJa: 家の周囲を調べておいてくれたらしい
findings.governingReading: Saber appears to have checked the area around their house
findings.explanation: The geographic scope expands from the Emiya home’s surroundings to the entire town.

findings.highlight: We went by the Matou household
findings.evidenceJa: 念の為間桐邸にも立ち寄った
findings.governingReading: they also stopped at the Matou residence as a precaution
findings.explanation: The reason for checking the mansion disappears.

findings.highlight: a day since Caster was eliminated
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターが消えてから一日
findings.explanation: The source’s disappearance wording becomes a confirmed defeat or killing.

findings.evidenceJa: 他のマスターも様子を見ている
findings.governingReading: the other Masters may be waiting to see how matters develop
findings.explanation: Saber’s tentative prediction of strategic hesitation becomes ongoing surveillance.
The work’s technical resource becomes generic energy.

findings.evidenceJa: 町に張り巡らされていた
findings.governingReading: which had been stretched throughout this town, Miyama
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts Shinto into the Miyama patrol branch and relocates Caster’s fading network.
A near-complete disappearance becomes an unspecified ongoing decline.
mirror moon adds a moral qualification absent from the technical assessment.

findings.highlight: There aren’t any Masters that will suck up magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力を奪うマスターはもういない
findings.governingReading: there is no longer a Master draining magical energy from the townspeople
findings.explanation: A singular present conclusion becomes a plural prediction about future behavior.

findings.highlight: as though we’re trapped inside a still image
findings.evidenceJa: 静止画に刷り込まれたようなそら寒さ
findings.governingReading: a chill as though the town were imprinted into a still image
findings.explanation: Visual arrest and uncanny cold become literal entrapment of the characters.

findings.highlight: There is nothing wrong with this area
findings.evidenceJa: こちら側に異状はない
findings.governingReading: there is no detected abnormality on this side
findings.explanation: A patrol finding within limited perception becomes an absolute claim that the area is fine.
